changelog: 1.0.0.0: the games from Playnite appear as virtual entries in a Jellyfin library chosen by name, without entries in Jellyfin's database; games from every store and games added by hand, with Jellyfin's own tabs, sort, filters, paging and image cache; the same game from several stores grouped into one tile with store icons or a number as version marker; a detail page with Playnite's data, versions and links; start and install buttons through Playnite or the store; an admin page with all settings.
description: Shows the games from Playnite, from every store and added by hand, in a Jellyfin library, without adding them to Jellyfin's database.
name: Playnite Bridge
overview: Reads Playnite's library read-only and presents its games from every store like movies in a library of your choice: poster tiles, detail page, start button.
